memoryBuilder.verseText: God, make a clean heart in me. Make me new inside.

sequence.prompt: What happened with King David? Put it in order.

items.label: David hid it and felt heavy inside
David said sorry, and God forgave

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: It made David feel heavy and grey
He told a story instead of shouting
It came because God is merciful

application.question: David felt better once he stopped hiding. Who could you tell about something you have been keeping in?

options.label: Tell a grown-up who loves me

application.followUp: David did not say 'but' and he did not blame anybody. He just said, 'I have done wrong.' And God forgave him straight away — not because David was good enough, but because God is merciful. God makes hearts clean.
